classical case of a 29 year-old woman with rash over the face, neck and upper trunk with bilateral upper and lower limb swelling + weakness"},"content":{"type":"html","$t":"A 29 year old woman hailing for Choutuppal came to the medicine OPD with the chief complaints of rash over the face, neck and upper trunk with dark colored skin lesions over the knuckles since 10 months.\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EShe also complained of joint pains in bilateral upper and lower limbs especially in the knees, elbows, wrists and other small joints which is associated with morning stiffness since 10 months. She complains of swelling in bilateral hands, legs and generalized weakness since 10 months.\u0026nbsp; She also complains of an inability to comb her hair and inability to sit down in the floor.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EShe has a history of photosensitivity (increased itching after sun exposure). She had oral and genital ulcers on and off.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EShe also has a history of hair loss since 10 months. History of white discharge since 10 months.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cb\u003E\u003Cu\u003EPast history and Family history :\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/u\u003E\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENo other Co-morbidities present. None of her family members suffer with the same problem.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cb\u003E\u003Cu\u003EMarital history :\u003C\/u\u003E\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EShe has been married for 14 years. She has tried to conceive but has no children. She denies having any abortions.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cb\u003E\u003Cu\u003EMenstrual history :\u003C\/u\u003E\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EShe bleeds for 3 days every 30 days. Has regular menstrual cycles and uses 2 pads\/day.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cu\u003E\u003Cb\u003EVitals :\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/u\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ETemp : Afebrile\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPR : 76 BPM\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EBP : 120\/70 mm of Hg\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ERR : 17 CPM\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cb\u003E\u003Cu\u003EOn general examination :\u003C\/u\u003E\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EShe has mild Pallor and Pedal edema.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENo icterus, cyanosis, clubbing, kilonychia, lymphadenopathy.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cb\u003E\u003Cu\u003EOn local examination\u003C\/u\u003E\u003C\/b\u003E :\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EDiffuse, mottled, Erythema tours, hyperpigmentation noted on cheeks (\u003Cb\u003EMalad rash\u003C\/b\u003E) , nose (bridge) \u003Cu\u003Einvolving the nasolabial folds\u003C\/u\u003E, ears\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\"separator\" style=\"clear: both;
